response.sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS amount_spent FROM Customer AS c LEFT JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId), customer_shares AS (SELECT amount_spent, 1.0 * amount_spent / NULLIF(SUM(amount_spent) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM customer_totals), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM customer_shares) SELECT AVG(cs.amount_spent) AS average_amount_spent, AVG(cs.share) AS average_share, AVG(cs.share - a.share) AS average_share_above_average FROM customer_shares AS cs CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE cs.share > a.share
